items.text: Ghawooda jea eataw fuga mideawa mureeda

“Inyas giileeysiit ng'asheega ghuuta NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U, ak gisini badiida aba ging'ooyda diigheanyeekaaschi sean earukuneey askweareani, abeeda NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U gayghoaghaambiinyi ea naawana eemoojiga sean bea muunda ng'eanyiida.
Nea gaynyasa ghawooni seaniin nea gayghoah gaagu, inyas giileeysiit ng'asheega ghuuta NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U.
Gajeebadiischeesa mujiinajeagaagu, ea madameagaagu.
Gajeebadiischeesa jiilnangaagu, ea boagaagu bea madamnyeanda, ea muhooga dugwaagu, nea gooheadiischi dugwaagu ea dayeega noagaagu.
Gajeebadiischeesa sooscheekaagu ea gweerajeagaagu bea dearanga.
Gajeegoonyi ghawooda iiwi gah, ak gajeegoonyi ghawooda iriti jarooda.
“Gayghamwaashta NG'UTAMIIDA weajoodigaagu buwa ng'ucheewana ak geajoar aba madeadaang'u; gayghapka headaang'u nea gwasku seawadeanagi, ak gamng'awa madeadaang'u nea gwasik seawuut ispwa.
NG'UTAMIIDA gayghwanung' ghwanyas ghawooda gijigoongaagu, ea gadiyoojigaagu; ak gaygagoonyi ghawooda aba jeeda ng'eanyiida goonyi NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U.
Ak NG'UTAMIIDA gayghwanung' wasa siida ghaydit aba headaanyi, gawuurji gida aksiinda habeawooda, iing'waanyi digheanyeeka NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U, nea giyaadi naweadaanyi.
Abeeda eemoojiga sean bea badayda ng'eanyiida gayghwadaah gideaba geeguureeweeyi aba gheawunga NG'UTAMIIDA; abeeda gayghoawalnyi.
Nea NG'UTAMIIDA gayghwanung' baruura, aba jeacheengaagu ea muhooga, dugwaagu, ea aba booga madamnyeandaang'u, ea aba ng'eanyiida aksa NG'UTAMIIDA habeawooda ghweanigaagu gideaba gaygagoonyi.

Gaygwajeaneey NG'UTAMIIDA gheaseeda humng'eeda, gwanyakneey roopta ng'eanyiidaang'u aba damandaanyi nea gaygabadiischeesa gadiyoojiga geatingaagu; ak ang'iing'i gayghara eemoojiga saang'a, nea ea majalaaja eara gilagi.

NG'UTAMIIDA gayghwanung' huwa uhuuda nea ea mayhuuwa shoomng'eanda; nea gaygalacha mwadi, nea ea maybiikta bwadaw; iing'waanyi digheanyeeka NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U, earukuneey askweareani, nea gisini badiida aba ging'ooyda.
Iimoayami geat ak ghoanung'wi heeda ng'asheega earukuneegwa askweareani, agala geatinda dugwa ghanea dea ghaadaam, aba eadita geeshta badita aseecheeka suurja.
Gichea ghwanyas fuga mandeawana mureeda

“Inyas ea miileeysiini iit ng'asheega ghuuta NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U ghana ang'waanya muuchi diigheanyeekaaschi sean ea deaweedajeagaaschi earukuneey askweareani, abeeda gaynyasa mooshteayeeksu seaniin nea gaygoobiida headaang'u.
Gajeamwaashta mujiinajeagaagu, ak eara madameagaagu gajeamwaashta.
Gajeamwaashta sooscheekaagu ea gweerajeagaagu bea dearanga.
Gajeamwaashta jeacheangaagu, ea booga madamnyeandaang'u, ea giiheadiischooda dugwaagu ea dayeega noagaagu.
Gajeamwaashtaneey iwuni ghoah, ea iriti jarooda hean gajeamwaashtaneey.
“NG'UTAMIIDA gaygwajakneey mooshteayda ea muuwda ea giyoonda, aba jeeda gilinyoo sina, bwak ea bay meawa aba ng'asheagaagu munyas isinayi, aba gideaba ninung'usean heeda.
Gaygwajakneey NG'UTAMIIDA geeyoonung'weaka munyas jea ghwaaknyi ea ashealana aba jeeda ng'eanyiida jea una ambala.
Ak gayghwalasnyi aba weasheanda ea sheagheeda ea sheagheeda ng'waan, ea geejeeda, ea daknooda, ea shaarara; gaygamaseawneey ea meawa.
Nea humng'eeda laabwaneey heeda diyeada gaygawuurji lagheanga duwas, nea ng'eanyiida laabwaneey ng'eanyi gaygawuurji gharinyeanda.
Ak NG'UTAMIIDA gayghwanung' ghoah roopta ng'eanyiidaang'u birjeanda ea sigeeda, gaygang'eena humng'eeda ak gwadukunyi ea meawa.

“Gayghwanung' NG'UTAMIIDA gayghamwaashtaneey weajoodigaagu, gajuna ng'ucheewana nea giyaadi naweanagi, ak gaymang'awana madeeda nyaawa aba naweadin ispwa; ak gaywoosa siichea ghoawal eemoojiga sean bea muunda ng'eanyiida.
Nea mustaang'u gayghoah daghwarda dariidaka ng'eetiida, ea diyeanga jeeda ng'eanyiida; eamudu gwanda siichea ghahoan.
Gayghwalasnyi NG'UTAMIIDA aba sibirbirgwajeega ghayi ak fuga Misri, ea deaneaduutka ea nyawiishta ea ng'oowshooda jea ea majamuusa haabwa.
Gayghwalasnyi NG'UTAMIIDA aba ak gang'ulnyi geeska ea ng'oowunda ea indabiida;

Gaywadiina nea giing'oonyeadayi ng'eanyi askweari, gawuurji giduurdooschi beata siida ng'oaw, nea ea maynyasa gil aba gilinyoo sina, nea gaywoosa siichea eeghabwaas nea giweasi giing'oonyaneeda eawoojigaagu sean, nea maygwanda siichea ghaweanyi.
Gajanyeara gatmooda, ak gaygwaluudayi siida nuut; gaydeasa ghooriida, ak ea majabiidana jeeda, gayng'aapta geeta sabiibu, ak ea majaga haghweagaaschi.

Gajeejeeng'sa madeadaang'u heeydaang'u ak ea majamuusa aga banyeagaaschi, nea gajeawaas aba uurda digeadaang'u ghang'amwa headaang'u, ak nea ea majeeteelneey, eara gisilgaagu gajeataw weajoodigaagu, nea ea maygwanda siichea ghaweanyi.
Orjoagaagu ea haweagaagu gayghwaat eemoojiga suuk ghoah soomjooga, ak gajang'weeriida eawoojiga sean aba giimuukuunooda nyaawa, nea geatingaagu ea maygwandeawa uurda jea goodeelu.
Nea eemeeda minali gayghwaak haghweega madamnyeandaang'u ea gadiyoojiga iisini aba uurdaang'u; gajeeghabasnyi nea geesawanyi galeaga sean;
ak abeeda gaygang'ulnyi geeska aba gichea ghwadaah gheanyangaagu.
Gayghwalasnyi NG'UTAMIIDA aba geeyooda was sibirbirgwajeega jea ghwaak geeshangaagu ea gutung'weakaagu jea ea majamuusa haabwa, gidang'eada baneaguuka geeshangaagu ea gagul uhuudaang'u.

“Ak gayghwaanyi NG'UTAMIIDA, ang'iing'i ea sugoocheandaang'u jea loada ghoahaaghwaneey ea aweayeena heeda eemeeda minali ang'iing'i ghana ghweanigaagu, hean aba hoowa gaybwada aseecheeka suuk was gea geediga ea lagheanga.
Ak gayhuuwa siichea ghahamng'eanyi buuneeda nea gaygabareeweey reari nea gajeefoolnyi aba bugusta eemoojiga jea ghoadoabiiwnyi NG'UTAMIIDA.
Gajaada mbeeyooda saang'a ak gihisti aba madamnyeanda, ak hean gaylaja boosu ng'ay; aba gideaba gayghwaak deashamga.
Gayhista sabiibu ak gisisini, ak ea gajamuusa leaha difaayeadaanyi nea ea majamuusa laja sabiibu, aba gideaba gayghwaak ghupchajeega.
Gaymideawana geediga saytuunajeega aba jeeda ng'eanyiidaang'u sean, nea ea mayeashta nagheadaanyi, aba gideaba gayghoabitbidu dayeagaaschi.
Gayjiila diibiga orjooga ea haweega, nea ea mayghoah gaagu, aba gideaba gaygaweay ghoah soomjooga.
Geedigaagu sean ea haghweega madamnyeandaang'u gaygoombal deashamga.
Nea rabascheanda mida headaang'u gaygabaruur muuchi nea gaburdeaweey uurda, nea ang'iing'i gaygoosha uurdaang'u nea gibwarbwariidi.
Niny gaygooleacheeweey, nea ang'iing'i ea majalaajana niny; niny gayghoah uhuuda nea ang'iing'i gayhuuwa shoomng'eanda.

Nea mooshteayeeksu seaniin gayghapka headaang'u nea gayghwaaknyi ak ghwaduupnyi bwak ea meawa, aba gideaba miileeysiini iit ghuuta NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U, aba ging'ooyda diigheanyeekaaschi ea deaweedajeagaaschi rukuneey.
Gayghoah headaang'u gwadeagooda ea deamdeamanga ea aba jiilnangaagu damanda manda muudeanooda.
“Aba gideaba miibwada NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U aba hooseaneega ea ng'weelooda guroorooda, aba seang'ayda haleanjeeda sean,

ak hean gadiyeesiina weajoodigaagu jea gwajakneey NG'UTAMIIDA, nea gaybearjeewana jalooda ea muwooshta, ea dawiishnata, ea gasooda haleanjeeda sean; ak gaygwarasa gheataang'u yookeeda gharinyeanda ea gwanuusnyi.
Gaygweadu NG'UTAMIIDA eemeeda leabu heeda sheagi, leabu muudeanooda ng'eanyiida, gayghoanda gidatkwealiida madooyda, eemeeda miyiinyi iita nyaawa,
eemeeda ng'weani gheanyan, moamu gwasamsa gweargweeda ghana ghabwayda gheareemaneeda,

ak gayghwaak muhooga dugwaagu ea booga madamnyeandaang'u, bwak ea meawa, nea ea mayghwanung'waneey booga, ea difaayi, ea nagheeda, ghana gooheadiischi dugwaagu ea dayeega nooga ea gisilgaagu, bwak ea gwanuusnyi.

Fiisu gayghaghasnyi aba jeeda gealgaagu, bwak ea ghamarjeakaagu geawi sijabwa gealgaagu, eawoojisu isisi masaweega, gaygang'adeesa ng'eanyiida sean was daang'u, nea gayghaghasnyi aba jeeda gealgaagu aba meatkwajeega sean bea ng'eanyiidaang'u abeeda goonyi NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U.
Ak gajaga banyeega jilnangaagu, banyeega orjoagaagu ea haweagaagu, goonyi NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U aba jeeda ghasooda ea sawanadeeda jea gwasawananeey weajoodigaagu.
Siida miy nea inya jih aba jeedeang'wa gayghaweada hamita orjeeda ghwaan ea gatmoadaanyi bwariiy ea baleandaanyi siipuusa niny;

nea ea maygwalaksa fugaaschi banyeega jea ghwaak bea diibigaaschi, aba gideaba manda gida siipuusa headaanyi damanda ghaseadaang'u ea sawanadeadaang'u jea gwasawanyi weajoocheandaang'u aba jeeda mujiinajeagaagu sean.

Nea gatmooda miy inya jih mida jeedeang'wa, nea ea miighanyi ghwayiin baneakta geeshtaanyi ng'eanyi aba gideaba ea miy ak ea inya jih, gaygwashiisa ghaang' siyeadaanyi bwariiy ea orjeedaanyi ea hudaanyi,

hean eara geacheeda rituuna dageascheeda geeshangaaschi ea diibigaaschi jea gwaji, aba gideaba gayghwaak aba makcheameeda, aba gasooda haleanjeeda sean, aba ghasooda ea sawanadeeda jea gwasawanyi weajoocheandaang'u aba jeeda gealgaagu sean.
“Inyas ea misini badiida ging'ooyda ng'asheega sean bea diigheanyeeksu sing'oorsa jeedeaba gitaaboaniin, ak hean giiwali gheawunga ghaambiidaat haloat bea NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U,
hean abeeda gaygweaneey NG'UTAMIIDA ea jilnangaagu sawanaduutka ng'weani sawanaduutka jea ghwashng'u, ea geeyoonung'weaka haloodi maygoosha.
Gayghoahaaknyi gicha geeyoonung'weaka ng'eanyiida Misri, ghayi iwalayi, ak gayghwaaknyi.
Gilinyoo ea geeyooda gil, ea gilinyoo ea sawanadeeda meeng'oorsiina jeedeaba gitaaboani bea diigheanyeeksuun, gayghoahaaknyi NG'UTAMIIDA, bwak ea meawa.
Nea abeeda goodeeneawi miinga humng'eeda aba seang'ayda, gajooshealana ea eapuudeegwa fiisu ng'ay, aba gideaba miileeysiini iit ng'asheega ghuuta NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEATAANG'U.

Gawuurji gidahoosanda NG'UTAMIIDA aba gida goondaneegwa miyinda nea ghoahaadeagwa, hean NG'UTAMIIDA ghoamu gahoosan iijakneegwa miyeeda ea giishealdeang'wa, ak agooga gajeang'aamwaneegwa jeeda ng'eanyiida jea aweayeena oombala.

Gaygoodearseey NG'UTAMIIDA jeeda eemoojiga sean, gidang'eada meatkweenagi bea ng'eanyiida ea gagul niirja; nea aba hoowa gaybwada aseecheeka suuk, bea geediga ea lagheanga, gea minali ang'iing'i ghana ghweanigaagu.
Nea aba jeedeaba eemoojisu ea maynyasa fuufeanda, nea ea maygwanda heechea gafuufa geeshangaagu; ak NG'UTAMIIDA gaygagoonyi aba hoowa, muuwda, ea burooda uhuuda, ea sawanadeeda guroorooda;
eaweagaagu gaygwanda jeeda muuwda, askweari ea eawa gajabiidana jeeda giyoonda, nea ea maynala gichea abiideata.
Sakteayda gajeena, ‘Gideabali ghoah shing'ada!’ Aba shing'ada gajeena, ‘Gideabali ghoah sakteayda!’ aba giyoonda jea ghwanyiit gurooroadaang'u, ea gichea ghwadaah gheanyangaagu.

Ak gayghoadealdaneey NG'UTAMIIDA ng'eanyiida Misri aba maleambajeega, aba bareanyeeka ghayi earukuneegwa gideaba maygudu abiikta gicha; aba hoowa gajashaayda geat aba heeda weajoodigeagwa ak ghoahuuyi soomjooga was headiga ea gea haweega, ak ea maygwanda siichea ghwashaaheegwa.”
